## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check:widget-ui`
- [ ] `npm run compile`
- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] UI changes: screenshots and keyboard, RTL/LTR, theme and font-size checks
- [ ] Network, permissions, storage migration, dependencies and privacy reviewed if applicable
